title: Link upstream acknowledgement
description: Spec 63. Sent by the acceptor on the same socket only when it GRANTED the upstream role to an api_key Hello. A refused Hello gets no acknowledgement at all, so this schema has no refusal form. It echoes the Hello's link_incarnation_id beside the acceptor-created, unpredictable upstream_binding_id; the dialer enables upstream only on an acknowledgement that echoes both from the same socket. granted_roles is exactly [upstream]: an api_key never yields serve. records_prompt_content is conservative (true unless the acceptor positively asserts it records none). reads_traffic_class absent means false; a dialer sends meta.traffic_class only when it is true.

principal_label.description: Pseudonymous label of the key's principal; never the principal id.
